findings.behavior: One shared eventFrame; SPELL_UPDATE_CHARGES immediately calls UpdateCount for action-bearing ActiveButtons. No BAG_UPDATE, BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED or SPELL_UPDATE_USES registration in this file.
ActiveButtons tracks HasAction rather than visibility; OnShow performs full update; OnHide only reevaluates per-frame state/flash update demand.
UpdateCount writes GetDisplayCount directly. Modern action/spell implementations use native display-count APIs; generic legacy fallback chooses consumable/stackable count or multi-charge count.
Classic Era optional LibClassicSpellActionCount replaces Action.GetCount with live reagent item count; .pkgmeta dependency is not a repaint scheduler.
Shared OnUpdate services dirty state/flash and range work; it does not poll item/reagent counts.

classicReagentLibrary.findings: Maps known Classic spell IDs to reagent item IDs and reads GetItemCount on demand. Provides no bag-event queue or per-frame count polling. This library fixes a historical count API limitation rather than update scheduling.

findings.behavior: Distinct shared Usable/Text owners: BAG_UPDATE marks usability and text; SPELL_UPDATE_CHARGES marks text; player UNIT_AURA marks text. Event handlers only set Full dirty flags, coalescing repeated same-frame events.

One generated shared OnUpdate sees RefreshButtons, loops allocated ActiveButtons for requested facets, then clears flags. It updates texture for every dirty batch as well. Count work is dirty-driven; the OnUpdate remains installed.
ActiveButtons means allocated rather than visible. Hidden allocated buttons remain in count loops.
BAG_UPDATE also immediately invokes the separate global bag-index cache rebuild.
CacheBagItems scans all carried bag slots per BAG_UPDATE. This part should not be copied into Flux's lightweight count refresh.

Spell counts resolve active override then write native display-count string; item counts request uses; macros delegate to their displayed item/spell mode; bonus actions use native action display count.
Shown flyout observes BAG_UPDATE and refreshes visible child count/usability. Hiding unregisters BAG_UPDATE.
No SPELL_UPDATE_USES or BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED registration in inspected local addon. It uses bag changes to keep reagents current.

recommendation.reason: Flux's existing shared inventory notifications plus new coalesced count/usability invalidation cover the behavior demonstrated by these references. Nothing here requires merchant, loot, mail or trade-specific handlers, count polling, copied third-party code or another framework.
recommendation.retain: Keep current native/legacy API adapters, modern opaque display-text handling, visibility/demand ownership, next-frame coalescing and FormStorm held dirty flags. Keep cooldown, identity, secure attributes and inventory scans outside count-only invalidation.
recommendation.nativeAcceptance: Still required for Light Feather 19->20 through loot/vendor/trade/mail, depletion/refill, charges, macro/modifier displays, hidden reveal and combat on each supported client; comparison cannot prove no lag.
